Which statement describes isotopes of the same element?
A
They have different electron arrangements.
B
They have different nuclear charges.
C
They have nuclei with masses that are the same.
D
They have the same number of protons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have nuclei with masses that are the same.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of protons.
